blocks.text: Stand-up comedian Arnell Tamayo, who also had acting stints in the TV sitcom “Okay Ka, Fairy Ko!” and the film “Maria Leonora Teresa,” died on Wednesday, Oct 14. He was 61. Tamayo’s death was confirmed through a statement shared on his Facebook page on Wednesday. “It is with profound sadness and heavy hearts that we announce the passing of Arnell Tamayo, a beloved Filipino entertainer whose humor, unmistakable personality, fabulous presence, and gift for making people smile touched the lives of so many,” it read. “Arnell was more than an entertainer.
